header.title: Journey Timeline
header.subtitle: Career milestones and selected public projects, with links to the work behind them.

items.title: Senior Frontend Developer at PT Ada Ide Langsung Jalan
items.descriptions: Build web and mobile features across Smartlink and Groapp, with a focus on architecture, API integration, performance, reusable components, and code quality. Collaborate with product and backend teams.

items.title: Valfuse Node: reusable TypeScript tooling
items.descriptions: Built a public toolkit spanning form state, validation, localization, and asset generation, with React, Vue, and Express integrations. It brings shared behavior into product applications without tying it to one UI framework.

items.title: Flutter Inspector: border radius contribution
items.descriptions: Added access to individual corner-radius values from BoxDecoration in the Inspector, making UI inspection more precise.

items.title: Flutter tooling for localization and UI tests
items.descriptions: Published localization_gen to generate typed translation APIs from modular JSON, then automation_keys_gen to standardize and document Flutter test keys. Both address recurring maintenance work in larger app codebases.

items.title: Frontend input security research
items.descriptions: Compared HTML sanitization in React and Flutter through working demos and automated tests using more than 60 XSS payload cases. The repository documents the approach and its limits for frontend teams.

items.title: flutter_image_compress — iOS 26 compatibility proposal
items.descriptions: Proposed replacing ALAsset-based image metadata handling with PHAsset for iOS 26 compatibility. Maintainers merged a different fix and closed this pull request.

items.title: Frontend Developer Lead at PT Ada Ide Langsung Jalan
items.descriptions: Led frontend delivery across web, mobile, and cross-platform products. Planned priorities and resources, mentored developers, reviewed code, and established reusable foundations and technical standards.

items.title: Back End Developer at Stellarlab
items.descriptions: Worked part-time with Node.js and MongoDB. Collaborated closely with mentors to improve scalable backend systems.

items.title: Mobile Developer at PT Ada Ide Langsung Jalan
items.descriptions: Developed core features for the Smartlink cashier app using Flutter, following DDD and Clean Architecture principles.

items.title: Android Developer at CV Gumcode
items.descriptions: Developed Android apps and features for client projects.
